profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Lucid Software
profile.summary:
Technical Lead & Software Engineer specializing in AI/LLM system architecture, full-stack web applications, and agentic canvas tools.
Currently at Lucid Software, where I lead engineering teams building next-generation AI editing capabilities, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and automated evaluation workflows. I thrive at the intersection of complex system design, cross-functional technical leadership, and engineering mentorship.
Core Expertise: TypeScript | Python | Scala | React | AWS | Snowflake | LLM Tooling & Agentic Systems | Engineering Leadership & Agile Mentorship
🎓 MS & BS in Information Systems Management from Brigham Young University.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Technical Lead for the AI Canvas Editing initiative at Lucid. I lead a team of 5 engineers building cutting-edge agentic editing tools, real-time LLM integrations, and enterprise canvas capabilities.
Key Contributions & Impact: 
🚀 AI Architecture & Agentic Systems: Lead and architected projects including improving core document representations and interactions, LLM tool/skill integration systems, and rich editing capabilities within the Lucid Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
⚡ System Modernization & Velocity: Led a major AI system re-architecture across cross-functional teams, streamlining release schedules and reducing negative product feedback by 50%. 
🤖 Automated AI Evaluation: Built automated AI evaluation and feedback workflows leveraging LLM pipelines and Atlassian automations, cutting manual engineering and stakeholder review cycles by 80%. 
📈 Engineering Leadership: Direct manager for 3 software engineers. Provide technical mentorship, system design coaching, and career development—boosting team sprint velocity by 30%. 
📊 Strategy & Telemetry: Partner with engineering leadership on OKRs/KPIs. Built automated Snowflake data warehouse dashboards to report platform health and adoption to executive leadership. 
💡 AI Community Leadership: Spearheaded company-wide AI adoption workshops, training 150+ engineers on integrating AI tools into daily development workflows.

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.description:
•	Develop full-stack sites using ASP.NET Framework and JS/REACT
•	Work closely with Creative Works' clients to create, update, and maintain sites dedicated to their research and findings
•	Deploy fully functional website to Amazon Web Services (AWS) and monitor website status and log

positions.title: Student Crew Team Lead - Air Conditioning Shop
positions.description:
•	Performed essential maintenance on industrial cooling and heating systems while managing team of 6 other student employees. 
•	Worked with supervisor to assign and complete tasks within a required time frame and expected quality. 
•	Spent 40+ hours organizing air filter data for over 200 industrial air handling units into a shared Microsoft Excel file to be used and edited for strategic use by shop employees.
•	Coordinated with 4 full-time facilities workers the 67% decrease in on hand requirements of filter stock. 
•	Facilitated the indexing, calculating, and moving of excess stock across campus according to university facilities' needs.

positions.title: Data Entry Specialist
positions.description:
•	Researched and updated graduated and current students records for the University magazine and contact information
•	Worked with a team of students to accomplish goals for updating a specific number of records before magazine and contact deadlines
•	Mastered data storage programs and efficiently navigated and updated information stored in the software programs

positions.title: Software Engineer Program Intern
positions.description:
Created Enterprise Search POC using ReactJS to be used by over 200,000 employees worldwide. 
Guided less experienced developers in learning and implementing React framework

positions.title: Implementation Consultant Intern
positions.description:
•	Assist in the implementation and upkeep of Nebraska's Department of Motor Vehicles software that stores and processes over 3 million vehicle records
•	Brainstorm creative solutions to a variety of issues within the software, making changes to production software 2-3 times a week
•	Collaborate with the client and team members to ensure software is fulfilling client needs

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Instructed over 200 students from many academic backgrounds in an introductory information systems course 
Responsible for recording and assigning grades to 65 students in addition to corresponding with them about grade questions and concerns
Create new ways to explain topics dealing with SQL, VBA, HTML, and general computer knowledge to students needing further help outside of class instruction

company.name: Brigham Young University Marriott School of Business

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
•	Provided one-on-one private tutoring for academically struggling high school and college students 
•	Learned principles of education and tutoring that allow me to connect with students on an individual and personal level
•	Learned methods of helping students come to conclusions on their own, and encouraging them to continue working on difficult tasks

positions.title: Personal Finance Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Researched, compiled, and simplified information on a collection of financial topics most useful for average working adults
•	Collaborated with a team of 4 interns to determine most effective delivery methods for company goals and actions
•	Created 7 useful, yet concise infographics to be posted online for use by consumers

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
•	Prepared food to satisfy the needs of the guests
•	Maintained a clean work space, allowing for a safe food preparatory environment
•	Mentored new employees helping them become familiar with work duties
•	Performed closing and opening duties which taught me how to work hard and quickly
